integrity: The proof is elementary and reversible: coprimality reduces the problem to two pure prime-power neighbor equations, which are then exhausted by factorization and parity. Exact-integer finite checks independently stress-test the classification over broad bounded ranges.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to fixed prime support containing 2 and does not treat pairs of odd primes. It does not assert infinitude of either Mersenne or Fermat primes. The bounded verifier is a regression check, not part of the infinite proof. Differently phrased or unindexed prior observations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact Tian classification for fixed support \(\{2,q\}\)
